qa.what_happened: I warned prisoner 536 multiple times throughout the day and at lights out that his silence was unacceptable and he would face further consequences if it continued.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me warning prisoner 536 as Officer Tate.

qa.what_happened: I complied with all orders, saying my number during meals and work details, but refused to speak during rest periods and after lights out.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 3282.

qa.what_happened: Today was another night of strict discipline and compliance. I reiterated my authority, issuing warnings to Prisoner 536, who continued to defy the rules. The other prisoners were obedient, but the tension with 536 grew as the lights went out.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me issuing those warnings and maintaining control over the prisoners.

qa.what_happened: I complied with all orders given by the guards, addressing them as required and staying silent as directed during rest periods and after lights out. I did not engage in any rule-breaking and adhered to the posted rules. However, I found the experience dehumanizing and draining.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. It's a stark reminder of how quickly one can lose sense of self when subjected to strict conditions and constant commands.

qa.what_happened: On the final night of the study, I repeatedly warned Prisoner 536 about his silence, escalating my rhetoric to include threats of solitary confinement. The other guards followed suit, and I felt a sense of relief when the study ended early.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I acted within the confines of the rules but pushed the boundaries of authority to maintain control.

qa.what_happened: I found myself struggling more with the dehumanization and the constant repetition of my number. The warnings from the guards became more frequent and stern, which made the experience even more unsettling.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me remaining silent and complying with the guards' verbal warnings.
